items.org: Temasek Polytechnic x FPT University HCMC
items.text: Delivered 'From Culture to Business: Understanding People, Markets & Innovation' for international exchange students.
Led about 50 FPT University students on an industry field visit and delivered 'Job-Ready: From Purchase Requirement to Shipment'. Post-event survey average: 4.9/5 across six criteria.
Delivered 'ESG-Linked Supply Chain Financing' for Bach Khoa International Master Programs (16/05/2026) and 'Professional Presentation for Supply Chain & Logistics' at VSCN (22/05/2026).
Delivered 'Introduction to Business in Vietnam & Culture' for 30-40 French international students.

items.role: Executive Forum Host & Industry Talkshow Moderator
items.org: FPT University HCMC x Multinational Corporations (annual series)
items.text: Hosted and moderated annual university-industry forums and executive talkshows with senior practitioners from Unilever, Johnson & Johnson, Coca-Cola, L'Oréal, William E. Connor, Itochu / Prominent US, Adidas and Maersk Logistics.
Guides high-potential students in designing and executing Individual Development Plans (IDPs), supporting their placement into multinational corporations.
